LanguageData.LP_Feat_MagicInitiate.label: magic initiate
LanguageData.LP_Feat_MagicInitiate.description: Learned a little real magic. With VPE: pick the wizard, cleric or druid path based on the highest of Intellectual / Social / Plants and Animals, and learn that path's first ability (no path point, no path unlock needed). Without VPE: gain "Magic missile" (unerring, 8 + level force damage, range 20, about 3 per day). Grants +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_TavernBrawler.label: tavern brawler
LanguageData.LP_Feat_TavernBrawler.description: Fists forged in tavern brawls. Unarmed damage ×2.5, social fight damage ×2; unarmed hits have a 40% chance to push the enemy 1 cell and stun for 1 second. Grants +1 Strength or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Crafter.label: crafter
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Crafter.description: A skilled craftsman. General labor speed (crafting work) +25%; when the negotiator buys tools, weapons or apparel from traders, prices -20%. Grants +1 Dexterity or Intelligence.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Skilled.label: skill expert
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Skilled.description: Has learned a bit of everything. When taking the feat, the 3 highest-level skills whose passion is not yet "major" each go up one passion step (none → minor → major), and those 3 skills each gain +3 levels; global learning ×1.1. Grants +1 to any ability score (added to your current highest).
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Musician.label: musician
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Musician.description: Music that stirs the heart. When playing an instrument, colonists within 10 cells get mood +6 "rousing music" (half a day); the first performance each day gives up to 3 listeners "Inspired": surgery success, negotiation ability and shooting accuracy ×1.3 for 6 hours. Requires Charisma 13 or Artistic 6. Grants +1 Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ElementalAdept_Fire.label: elemental adept: fire
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ElementalAdept_Fire.description: Fire obeys this caster. Fire damage ignores the target's fire resistance (even fire giants can be burned) and is +25%. Requires a spellcasting class (wizard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, paladin or arcane trickster) or a worn holy symbol. Only one element can be chosen. Grants +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ElementalAdept_Cold.label: elemental adept: cold
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ElementalAdept_Cold.description: Cold obeys this caster. Cold damage ignores the target's cold resistance and is +25%. Requires a spellcasting class (wizard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, paladin or arcane trickster) or a worn holy symbol. Only one element can be chosen. Grants +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ElementalAdept_Lightning.label: elemental adept: lightning
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ElementalAdept_Lightning.descrip: Lightning obeys this caster. Lightning damage ignores the target's lightning resistance and is +25%. Requires a spellcasting class (wizard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, paladin or arcane trickster) or a worn holy symbol. Only one element can be chosen. Grants +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ElementalAdept_Acid.label: elemental adept: acid
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ElementalAdept_Acid.description: Acid obeys this caster. Acid damage ignores the target's acid resistance and is +25%. Requires a spellcasting class (wizard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, paladin or arcane trickster) or a worn holy symbol. Only one element can be chosen. Grants +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Observant.label: observant
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Observant.description: Nothing escapes these eyes. Research speed +25%; can see invisible units (those in shadow veils, invisibility potions, psychic invisibility, drow darkness). Requires Intelligence or Wisdom 13. Grants +1 Intelligence or Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Actor.label: actor
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Actor.description: A born liar and actor. Trade prices +10%, negotiation ability (recruiting etc.) ×1.3; ability "Disguise" (2 per day): for 2 minutes enemies will almost never prioritize targeting this person. Requires Charisma 13. Grants +1 Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Telepathic.label: telepathic
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Telepathic.description: Can send thoughts into other people's heads. Social impact ×1.15; ability "Soothe mind" (3 per day): instantly calm a colonist within 30 cells who is having a mental break. Grants +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Resilient_Mind.label: resilient: will
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Resilient_Mind.description: More strong-willed than most. Mental break threshold -15%, mind resistance +20%. One of three Resilient choices. Grants +1 Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Resilient_Toxic.label: resilient: poison
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Resilient_Toxic.description: The body is especially tough against poison. Toxic resistance +100% (toxins no longer build up), toxic environment resistance +50%, pain shock threshold +10%. One of three Resilient choices. Grants +1 Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Resilient_Immune.label: resilient: immunity
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Resilient_Immune.description: Rarely sick, and recovers fast when sick. Immunity gain speed ×2, rest recovery ×1.3, wound healing ×1.2. One of three Resilient choices. Grants +1 Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Chef.label: chef
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Chef.description: An outstanding cook. Cooking speed ×1.25; 35% chance to make an extra "snack" when cooking (mood +5, +25% wound healing for 6 hours). Requires Cooking 6. Grants +1 Constitution or Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Poisoner.label: poisoner
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Poisoner.description: Knows how to brew poison from herbs. Ability "Coat weapon in poison": uses 1 herbal medicine (carried or on the map), then the next 20 melee hits apply spider queen venom. Requires Crafting or Medicine 6. Grants +1 Dexterity or Intelligence.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_RitualCaster.label: ritual caster
LanguageData.LP_Feat_RitualCaster.description: Uses rituals to restore spent spells. Ability "Ritual casting" (2 per day): channel standing for 1 hour; the ability with the longest remaining cooldown finishes cooling down at once, and for 1 hour afterwards the next cast triggers no cooldown and adds no neural heat. Requires Intelligence or Wisdom 13 and a spellcasting class or holy symbol. Grants +1 Intelligence or Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_DwarvenFortitude.label: dwarven fortitude
LanguageData.LP_Feat_DwarvenFortitude.description: A dwarf's constitution. Toxic resistance +70%, pain shock threshold +10%; the first drink each day instantly heals 60 points of wounds. Mountain and hill dwarves only. Grants +1 Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_InfernalWrath.label: infernal wrath
LanguageData.LP_Feat_InfernalWrath.description: Getting hit only makes the fire in the blood burn hotter. After being attacked by an enemy, the next attack deals an extra 15 + adventurer level fire damage (5 second cooldown). Tieflings and aasimar only. Grants +1 Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ElvenAccuracy.label: elven accuracy
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ElvenAccuracy.description: Elven eyes never miss. Shooting accuracy ×1.15; another ×1.1 for drow in darkness and for high elves and wood elves in daylight. High elves, wood elves and drow only. Grants +1 Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_MagmaGrip.label: lava grip
LanguageData.LP_Feat_MagmaGrip.description: Lava flows in the fists. Unarmed and hammer/club melee hits have a 50% chance to ignite the target. Fire giants only. Grants +1 Strength.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_BloodRegen.label: bloodthirsty regeneration
LanguageData.LP_Feat_BloodRegen.description: Blood makes wounds heal faster. After a melee kill, instantly heal 60 points of wounds (stacks with rampage). Trolls only. Grants +1 Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_PhylacteryOath.label: phylactery oath
LanguageData.LP_Feat_PhylacteryOath.description: The soul is nailed to the phylactery by an oath. On the map where the phylactery is, instant-death effects (thousand-point hits like Power Word Kill, decapitation) down you instead. Liches only. Grants +1 Intelligence.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_BountifulLuck.label: streak of luck
LanguageData.LP_Feat_BountifulLuck.description: Luck is contagious. Halfling luck cooldown 3 days → 1 day; when it triggers, one ally within 3 cells also gets "borrowed luck" (the next wound that would down or kill takes only 10%). Halflings only. Grants +1 Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_GnomishCunning.label: gnomish ingenuity
LanguageData.LP_Feat_GnomishCunning.description: A gnome's mind turns fast. Mind resistance +35%; general labor speed ×1.4 when making clockwork toys and mechanical items (components, mechanical goods). Rock gnomes, forest gnomes and deep gnomes only. Grants +1 Intelligence.
